question: In 2025, what share of orders contained more than one item line? Compare average ordered units per order for one-line and multi-line orders; also report orders with no item line separately.

action.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders, COUNT_IF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT > 1) AS multi_line_orders, COUNT_IF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT > 1) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS multi_line_share_of_all_orders, COUNT_IF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 1) AS one_line_orders, AVG(IFF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 1, ITEM_QUANTITY, NULL)) AS avg_ordered_units_one_line_orders, COUNT_IF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 0) AS no_item_line_orders, COUNT_IF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT IS NULL) AS orders_with_unknown_line_count, COUNT_IF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT > 1) AS multi_line_order_count_for_average, AVG(IFF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT > 1, ITEM_QUANTITY, NULL)) AS avg_ordered_units_multi_line_orders FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'

action.answer: Among 4,359,773 orders recorded in 2025, 3,052,089 had more than one item line: 70.005700% of all orders. Average ordered units per order were 3.484769 for multi-line orders and 1.219753 for one-line orders (1,307,684 orders). No-item-line orders: 0. These averages use order-level item quantity, with each order counted once.
